{{< include ./_extensions/r-wasm/live/_knitr.qmd >}}

This page provides a **browser-side node-merging module** for the example CLL network. The user selects the treatment components to merge, gives the merged node a new name, chooses the CNMA model, and presses **Run node merging**. The code is hidden from the user; only the controls, network plot, and results are shown.

> The first execution may take some time because R and the required packages are loaded in the browser through WebAssembly. This module does not save user choices or create permanent analysis versions.

## Select components to merge

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

components_all = [
  "Acal", "BR", "Clb", "FCR", "I", "Ibr", "O", "R", "Ven", "Zanubrutinib"
]

viewof components_to_merge = Inputs.checkbox(
  components_all,
  {
    value: ["Acal", "Zanubrutinib"],
    label: "Components to merge"
  }
)

viewof new_node_name = Inputs.text({
  value: "SecondGenBTKi",
  label: "New merged component name"
})

viewof cnma_model = Inputs.radio(
  ["Additive", "Additive + Interaction"],
  {
    value: "Additive",
    label: "CNMA model"
  }
)

viewof run_analysis = Inputs.button("Run node merging")
```

## Validation rules

| Rule | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 2 components selected | Stop |
| Empty merged node name | Stop |
| Merged node name identical to one of the selected components | Stop |
| Self-comparison created, e.g. `A vs A` | Stop |
| A study becomes single-arm/non-comparative | Stop |
| Fewer than 3 treatment nodes remain | Stop |
| Network becomes disconnected | Warning, but the analysis is allowed to continue |
| Duplicate comparisons are created within the same study | Pool using inverse-variance weights |

## Network plot after merging

```{webr}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| input:
#|   - components_to_merge
#|   - new_node_name
#|   - cnma_model
#|   - run_analysis

library(dplyr)
library(netmeta)
library(igraph)

dat <- data.frame(
  study = c("study 1", "study 2", "study 3", "study 4", "study 5",
            "study 6", "study 7", "study 8", "study 9", "study 10",
            "study 11", "study 12", "study 13", "study 14", "study 15"),
  treat1 = c("BR", "FCR", "FCR", "FCR", "Clb + O",
             "Clb + O", "Clb + O", "Clb", "Clb + O", "Clb + O",
             "BR", "FCR + BR", "FCR + BR", "FCR + BR", "Clb + O"),
  treat2 = c("I", "I + R", "I + R", "Ibr + Ven", "Ibr + Ven",
             "Ven + O", "Ibr + O", "I", "Acal + O", "Acal",
             "Zanubrutinib", "Ven + O", "Ven + O + Ibr", "Ven + R", "BR"),
  logHR = c(-1.021, -0.994, -0.82, -1.139, -1.31,
            -1.171, -1.386, -1.872, -1.967, -1.427,
            -1.238, -0.755, -1.204, -0.357, -0.6),
  selogHR = c(0.181, 0.162, 0.16, 0.238, 0.195,
              0.179, 0.227, 0.181, 0.177, 0.161,
              0.164, 0.193, 0.231, 0.082, 0.2)
)

replace_components_in_label <- function(lbl, components, new_name) {
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(lbl), "\\s*\\+\\s*")))
  parts[parts %in% components] <- new_name
  parts <- unique(parts)
  paste(parts, collapse = " + ")
}

merge_components <- function(dat, components, new_name) {
  components <- trimws(components)
  new_name <- trimws(new_name)

  if (length(components) < 2) {
    stop("Invalid merge: select at least two components.")
  }

  if (!nzchar(new_name)) {
    stop("Invalid merge: provide a non-empty merged node name.")
  }

  if (new_name %in% components) {
    stop("Invalid merge: the new node name must be different from the components being merged.")
  }

  d <- dat |>
    mutate(
      treat1_new = vapply(
        treat1,
        replace_components_in_label,
        FUN.VALUE = character(1),
        components = components,
        new_name = new_name
      ),
      treat2_new = vapply(
        treat2,
        replace_components_in_label,
        FUN.VALUE = character(1),
        components = components,
        new_name = new_name
      )
    )

  if (any(d$treat1_new == d$treat2_new)) {
    bad_studies <- unique(d$study[d$treat1_new == d$treat2_new])
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Invalid merge: self-comparison created in ",
        paste(bad_studies, collapse = ", "),
        ". This would create a treatment compared with itself."
      )
    )
  }

  df_trts <- bind_rows(
    d |> select(study, trt = treat1_new),
    d |> select(study, trt = treat2_new)
  )

  single_arm_tbl <- df_trts |>
    group_by(study) |>
    summarise(n_unique_trts = n_distinct(trt), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n_unique_trts <= 1)

  if (nrow(single_arm_tbl) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Invalid merge: after merging, the following studies become single-arm or non-comparative: ",
        paste(single_arm_tbl$study, collapse = ", "),
        ". Please choose a different component set."
      )
    )
  }

  pooled <- d |>
    transmute(
      study,
      t1c = pmin(treat1_new, treat2_new),
      t2c = pmax(treat1_new, treat2_new),
      TEc = ifelse(treat1_new <= treat2_new, logHR, -logHR),
      w = 1 / (selogHR^2)
    ) |>
    group_by(study, t1c, t2c) |>
    summarise(
      logHR = sum(w * TEc) / sum(w),
      selogHR = sqrt(1 / sum(w)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    rename(treat1 = t1c, treat2 = t2c)

  if (nrow(pooled) == 0) {
    stop("Invalid merge: no valid pairwise comparisons remain after merging.")
  }

  all_nodes <- unique(c(pooled$treat1, pooled$treat2))

  if (length(all_nodes) < 3) {
    stop("Invalid merge: fewer than three treatment nodes remain. NMA is not meaningful.")
  }

  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    pooled[, c("treat1", "treat2")],
    directed = FALSE
  )

  list(
    data = pooled,
    graph = g,
    connected = igraph::is.connected(g)
  )
}

res <- merge_components(dat, components_to_merge, new_node_name)
merged_dat <- res$data

cat("Selected CNMA model:", cnma_model, "\n")
cat("Selected components:", paste(components_to_merge, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("New merged component:", new_node_name, "\n\n")

if (!res$connected) {
  cat("Warning: the merged network is disconnected. Showing igraph network plot instead of netmeta::netgraph().\n")

  plot(
    res$graph,
    vertex.label.cex = 0.85,
    vertex.size = 24,
    edge.width = 2,
    main = "Disconnected merged network"
  )

} else {
  net_merged <- netmeta(
    TE = logHR,
    seTE = selogHR,
    treat1 = treat1,
    treat2 = treat2,
    studlab = study,
    data = merged_dat,
    sm = "HR",
    random = TRUE,
    common = FALSE,
    reference.group = "Clb + O"
  )

  netgraph(
    net_merged,
    plastic = FALSE,
    number.of.studies = FALSE,
    cex = 0.8
  )
}
```

## NMA summary after merging

```{webr}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| input:
#|   - components_to_merge
#|   - new_node_name
#|   - cnma_model
#|   - run_analysis

library(dplyr)
library(netmeta)
library(igraph)

dat <- data.frame(
  study = c("study 1", "study 2", "study 3", "study 4", "study 5",
            "study 6", "study 7", "study 8", "study 9", "study 10",
            "study 11", "study 12", "study 13", "study 14", "study 15"),
  treat1 = c("BR", "FCR", "FCR", "FCR", "Clb + O",
             "Clb + O", "Clb + O", "Clb", "Clb + O", "Clb + O",
             "BR", "FCR + BR", "FCR + BR", "FCR + BR", "Clb + O"),
  treat2 = c("I", "I + R", "I + R", "Ibr + Ven", "Ibr + Ven",
             "Ven + O", "Ibr + O", "I", "Acal + O", "Acal",
             "Zanubrutinib", "Ven + O", "Ven + O + Ibr", "Ven + R", "BR"),
  logHR = c(-1.021, -0.994, -0.82, -1.139, -1.31,
            -1.171, -1.386, -1.872, -1.967, -1.427,
            -1.238, -0.755, -1.204, -0.357, -0.6),
  selogHR = c(0.181, 0.162, 0.16, 0.238, 0.195,
              0.179, 0.227, 0.181, 0.177, 0.161,
              0.164, 0.193, 0.231, 0.082, 0.2)
)

replace_components_in_label <- function(lbl, components, new_name) {
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(as.character(lbl), "\\s*\\+\\s*")))
  parts[parts %in% components] <- new_name

}

merge_components <- function(dat, components, new_name) {

  if (length(components) < 2) {
    stop("Invalid merge: select at least two components.")
  }

  if (!nzchar(new_name)) {
    stop("Invalid merge: provide a non-empty merged node name.")
  }

  if (new_name %in% components) {
    stop("Invalid merge: the new node name must be different from the components being merged.")
  }

  d <- dat |>
    mutate(
      treat1_new = vapply(
        treat1,
        replace_components_in_label,
        FUN.VALUE = character(1),
        components = components,
        new_name = new_name
      ),
      treat2_new = vapply(
        treat2,
        replace_components_in_label,
        FUN.VALUE = character(1),
        components = components,
        new_name = new_name
      )
    )

  if (any(d$treat1_new == d$treat2_new)) {
    bad_studies <- unique(d$study[d$treat1_new == d$treat2_new])
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Invalid merge: self-comparison created in ",
        paste(bad_studies, collapse = ", "),
        ". This would create a treatment compared with itself."
      )
    )
  }

  df_trts <- bind_rows(
    d |> select(study, trt = treat1_new),
    d |> select(study, trt = treat2_new)
  )

  single_arm_tbl <- df_trts |>
    group_by(study) |>
    summarise(n_unique_trts = n_distinct(trt), .groups = "drop") |>
    filter(n_unique_trts <= 1)

  if (nrow(single_arm_tbl) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "Invalid merge: after merging, the following studies become single-arm or non-comparative: ",
        paste(single_arm_tbl$study, collapse = ", "),
        ". Please choose a different component set."
      )
    )
  }

  pooled <- d |>
    transmute(
      study,
      t1c = pmin(treat1_new, treat2_new),

    group_by(study, t1c, t2c) |>
    summarise(
      logHR = sum(w * TEc) / sum(w),

res <- merge_components(dat, components_to_merge, new_node_name)
merged_dat <- res$data

cat("Merged pairwise dataset:\n")
print(merged_dat)

if (!res$connected) {
  cat("\nThe merged network is disconnected.\n")
  cat("The CNMA/NMA summary is not estimated for the full network in this browser-side module.\n")
  cat("Use the igraph plot above to inspect the disconnected components.\n")

} else {
  net_merged <- netmeta(
    TE = logHR,
    seTE = selogHR,
    treat1 = treat1,
    treat2 = treat2,
    studlab = study,
    data = merged_dat,
    sm = "HR",
    random = TRUE,
    common = FALSE,
    reference.group = "Clb + O"
  )

  cat("\nCNMA model selected:", cnma_model, "\n\n")

  if (cnma_model == "Additive") {
    cat("Additive CNMA model:\n\n")

    cnma_fit <- tryCatch(
      netcomb(net_merged),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (inherits(cnma_fit, "error")) {
      cat("Additive CNMA could not be estimated in this browser-side module.\n")
      cat("Error message:\n")
      cat(cnma_fit$message, "\n\n")
      cat("Fallback: standard NMA summary after merging:\n\n")
      print(summary(net_merged))
    } else {
      print(summary(cnma_fit))
    }

  } else {
    cat("Additive + Interaction CNMA model:\n\n")

    interaction_fit <- tryCatch({
      Cmat <- createC(net_merged)
      netcomb(net_merged, C.matrix = Cmat)
    }, error = function(e) e)

    if (inherits(interaction_fit, "error")) {
      cat("Additive + Interaction CNMA could not be estimated in this browser-side module.\n")
      cat("Error message:\n")
      cat(interaction_fit$message, "\n\n")
      cat("Fallback: standard NMA summary after merging:\n\n")
      print(summary(net_merged))
    } else {
      print(summary(interaction_fit))
    }
  }
}
```

## Notes for thesis interpretation

This is a **client-side sensitivity module**. It allows users to perform controlled node merging on the embedded example dataset, but it does not save choices to a database and does not create a permanent version history. For a full Living NMA platform with uploaded datasets, persistent versions, and user sessions, the Shiny/server version remains the correct production architecture.
